job.title: Business Development Manager
job.description:
The Opportunity
AccruePartners is expanding, and we’re looking for a Business Development Manager who is wired to hunt, compete, and create new business and develop new relationships. 
This is a true new-business development role for someone who is genuinely energized by opening doors, creating and building relationships from scratch, and turning cold prospects into long-term clients. You won’t be stepping into a mature book of business or simply managing existing accounts. You’ll be expected to identify whitespace, build your own pipeline, pursue net-new opportunities, and consistently convert relationships into revenue.
You’ll join an award-winning firm with 20+ years of market credibility, deep expertise across six business verticals, and the delivery capabilities to back up what you sell. We provide the platform, reputation, resources, and talent solutions.  You bring the drive to create opportunities where they don’t yet exist.

What You’ll Do
  • Create and develop business from the ground up. Proactively identify and pursue net-new clients through strategic outbound prospecting, referrals, networking, market intelligence, and direct executive outreach.
  • Own the top of the funnel. Build and continuously replenish a healthy pipeline rather than relying on inbound leads or existing relationships to generate results.
  • Open doors others can’t. Develop creative strategies to gain access to CFOs, Controllers, CHROs, CIOs, CMOs, and other senior decision-makers across AccruePartners’ six lines of business.
  • Turn cold into connected. Confidently initiate conversations with executives who may not know AccruePartners today and earn the right to become a trusted business partner.
  • Create demand. Go beyond responding to open requisitions. Uncover business challenges, workforce gaps, upcoming initiatives, and organizational needs that can be solved through project, interim, executive search, and direct-hire solutions.
  • Navigate complex sales cycles. Identify decision-makers, overcome objections, maintain momentum, negotiate effectively, and ask for the business.
  • Expand every opportunity. Once you establish a relationship, look beyond the initial need to introduce clients to AccruePartners’ broader capabilities across Accounting & Finance, HR, Corporate Operations, Financial Services, Marketing/Digital/Creative, and IT.
  • Own your number. Take personal accountability for prospecting activity, pipeline development, meetings, new logos, gross margin, and revenue generation.
  • Stay in the hunt. Demonstrate the persistence and resilience to continue pursuing high-value prospects when the first answer is “not now” or “we already have a partner.”

What You Bring
  • 5+ years of demonstrated new-business sales success within staffing, professional services, consulting, Big 4, or another solutions-based B2B environment.
  • A track record of personally generating net-new business, not simply inheriting or managing an established book of accounts.
  • Evidence that you can build a territory or pipeline from limited existing opportunity and consistently convert prospecting activity into meetings, opportunities, and revenue.
  • Comfort with high levels of proactive outreach to include cold calling, executive outreach, networking, referrals, and targeted prospecting.
  • The ability to articulate your sales metrics: pipeline created, new logos won, revenue generated, quota attainment, average deal size, sales cycle, and other measurable indicators of performance.
  • A competitive mindset and genuine desire to win business paired with the emotional intelligence to build credible, consultative executive relationships.
  • Persistence without becoming transactional. You know how to stay relevant, add value, overcome objections, and keep a prospect engaged over a long sales cycle.
  • Strong closing instincts. You are comfortable asking difficult questions, creating urgency, challenging assumptions, and directly asking for the business.
  • Entrepreneurial ownership. You don’t wait for someone to hand you leads, tell you whom to call, or create your pipeline for you.
  • Curiosity about how businesses operate and the ability to translate business challenges into talent, workforce, and project solutions.

job.title: Risk and Safety Officer
job.description:

  • Collaborative HR environment where safety, risk management, education, and employee partnership are key priorities

  • Opportunity to take ownership of a broad safety and risk management function with significant visibility across the organization
  • Ability to develop and improve safety policies, procedures, training programs, and risk management practices
  • Broad exposure to safety, workers’ compensation, insurance, claims, property, liability, and employee relations
  • Opportunity to work directly with operational teams and influence safety practices at the ground level
  • Role designed for someone who enjoys building programs, solving problems, and making actionable recommendations

  • On-site in the greater eastern Charlotte area with approximately 30% of the role involving fieldwork at various organizational locations

  • Lead and continuously improve safety and risk management programs, policies, procedures, and compliance initiatives across the organization
  • Conduct safety inspections and lead or coordinate root-cause investigations involving workplace injuries, vehicle accidents, property damage, and other incidents
  • Administer workers’ compensation and other claims while partnering with employees, insurance carriers, case managers, brokers, and claims representatives
  • Develop and deliver safety training and partner with operational teams to educate employees and promote practical, proactive safety practices
  • Monitor OSHA requirements and other applicable regulations, ensuring appropriate reporting, documentation, and corrective actions
  • Support insurance, property, liability, and broader risk management activities, including working with brokers and underwriters as needed
  • Partner with HR and operational leadership on employee investigations, safety concerns, and other sensitive workplace matters

 

HOW YOU ARE QUALIFIED

  • 3+ years of experience in occupational safety, risk management, workers’ compensation, claims, or a related field
  • Strong working knowledge of OSHA regulations, workplace safety, workers’ compensation, and risk management practices
  • Experience developing or improving safety programs, policies, procedures, or employee training
  • Experience conducting incident investigations and identifying root causes and preventative measures
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills with the ability to work effectively with both field-based employees and leadership
  • Experience in a municipal, manufacturing, construction, public safety, utilities, transportation, or other operational environment is highly relevant; relevant safety, risk, OSHA, or HR certifications are a plus

job.title: Inside Sales Associate
job.description:
Inside Sales Associate
AccruePartners · Charlotte, NC · Direct Hire · Entry level to 3 years

The Opportunity

AccruePartners is expanding and we’re looking for a Inside Sales Associate to join our internal team and help accelerate firm growth. You’ll join an award-winning firm with 20+ years of market presence, a Carolinas focus with national reach, and a reputation for placing top talent with some of the most recognized companies in the region.

This isn’t a support role — it’s a production seat. You’ll learn the business of recruiting and sales from people who are actively doing it, earn real commission from day one, and build a skillset that compounds throughout your career. If you’re competitive, relationship-driven, and motivated by performance-based earnings, this is where you want to start.

What You’ll Do
  • Own both sides of the staffing equation — you’ll recruit top candidates and develop client relationships with hiring managers, running full-cycle from first call to placement
  • Prospect and cold call hiring managers across the Carolinas to build and grow a client portfolio from our HQ near Uptown
  • Source, screen, and recruit candidates through direct outreach, LinkedIn, referrals, and job boards
  • Conduct phone and video interviews; assess fit and prepare candidates for client conversations
  • Manage your pipeline daily in Bullhorn; track activity, submittals, and results with consistency
  • Build relationships in person — at networking events, client visits, and in the market
  • Use tools like LinkedIn Recruiter, ChatGPT, Bullhorn and Bullhorn Amplify, and other platforms to research and identify talent
  • Communicate daily with professionals at the manager and hiring manager level — on the phone, on camera, and in writing
What You Bring
  • 0–3 years of professional experience; internships in sales, recruiting, staffing, or professional services count
  • Comfortable with high outbound activity — calls are your primary tool and you don’t shy away from them
  • Strong communicator in writing and on the phone; you can hold your own in a conversation with a VP-level decision maker
  • Motivated by performance-based pay — you want to see a direct connection between your effort and your earnings
  • Curious, coachable, and competitive with a genuine hunger to learn and improve
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; relevant experience considered in place of degree
  • Based in Charlotte, near Uptown and requires 5 days in office for the first 90 days - hybrid after 
Why AccruePartners
  • Real Earnings Early — Competitive base, uncapped commissions, and a clear payout structure. Clear path for advancement both professionally and financially.
  • Skills That Compound — You’ll develop sales, recruiting, negotiation, and relationship skills that transfer across any career path. Most of our senior producers started in seats like this one.
  • A Network You Inherit — AccruePartners has deep, long-standing client relationships across the Carolinas. You’re not building from zero.
  • Mentorship From Active Talent Partners and Client Success Managers — You’ll sit alongside and learn from recruiters and business developers who are still billing, not just managing.
  • A Defined Path Forward — Most associates advance to within 12–18 months based on production metrics, not tenure. From there, you can grow into team lead, vertical specialist, or account executive roles.
  • High-Performance Culture — Recognized as a Best Place to Work by the Charlotte Business Journal, our team operates with accountability, celebrates wins, and supports each other in getting there.

If This Sounds Like You… If you’re ready to build a career somewhere that rewards the effort you put in — you’ll feel right at home at AccruePartners.

job.title: Business Development Manager, Triad Market
job.description:
Business Development Manager – Triad Market

Market: Greensboro | Winston-Salem | High Point / Greater Triad
Company: AccruePartners

The Opportunity

AccruePartners is expanding our presence across the Carolinas, and we’re looking for a Business Development Manager to drive growth in the Triad market.

This is a true new-business development and market-building role for someone who is energized by opening doors, creating relationships from scratch, and turning prospects into long-term clients. You’ll have the opportunity to leverage the strength of an established, award-winning brand while taking ownership of growth across Greensboro, Winston-Salem, High Point, and the surrounding Triad market.

We’re looking for someone who sees whitespace as opportunity. Someone who wants to identify the companies we should know, find the decision-makers we need to meet, create conversations where none exist today, and ultimately convert those relationships into revenue.

You won’t simply manage an existing book of business. Your mandate is to hunt, build, and grow.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the Triad market. Develop and execute a territory strategy for identifying and penetrating high-value organizations throughout Greensboro, Winston-Salem, High Point, and the surrounding region.
  • Create net-new business. Proactively identify, pursue, and close new client partnerships across project-based, interim, executive search, and direct-hire solutions.
  • Build pipeline from the ground up. Generate opportunities through targeted prospecting, cold outreach, referrals, networking, market intelligence, and executive-level relationship development.
  • Open doors. Build relationships with CFOs, Controllers, CHROs, CIOs, CMOs, and other senior business leaders across AccruePartners’ six lines of discipline.
  • Create demand — don’t wait for it. Uncover business challenges, workforce gaps, organizational initiatives, and upcoming projects before they become open requisitions, then position AccruePartners as a strategic solution.
  • Partner closely with delivery. Work hand-in-hand with AccruePartners’ specialized recruiting and delivery teams to understand client demand, align the right talent solutions, and ensure we deliver on what we sell.
  • Turn market intelligence into opportunity. Maintain a constant feedback loop with delivery teams to understand talent availability, compensation trends, skill gaps, hiring activity, candidate movement, competitive activity, and other market indicators. Bring those insights back to clients and prospects to anticipate needs, add value, and create new business opportunities.
  • Connect both sides of the market. Share what you’re hearing from clients with delivery teams — and what delivery teams are seeing in the talent market with clients — positioning AccruePartners as a strategic partner with a real-time understanding of both client demand and talent supply.
  • Turn cold prospects into trusted partners. Develop relationships with organizations that may have little or no existing connection to AccruePartners and establish credibility through thoughtful, consultative business conversations.
  • Navigate and close complex sales opportunities. Identify key decision-makers, understand buying processes, overcome objections, create urgency, negotiate effectively, and confidently ask for the business.
  • Leverage the entire AccruePartners platform. Introduce clients to solutions across Accounting & Finance, HR, Corporate Operations, Financial Services, Marketing/Digital/Creative, and IT.
  • Expand relationships once you’re in. Turn an initial engagement into a broader partnership by identifying additional stakeholders, departments, business units, and workforce needs.
  • Own your number. Take personal accountability for prospecting activity, meetings, pipeline creation, new logos, gross margin, and revenue generation.
  • Become known in the market. Build a strong network and visible presence throughout the Triad business community, creating relationships that generate opportunities today and in the future.

What You Bring

  • 3–5+ years of successful new-business sales experience within staffing, professional services, consulting, Big 4, or another solutions-oriented B2B environment.
  • A demonstrated track record of personally generating net-new business, rather than primarily managing or growing an inherited book of accounts.
  • Proven ability to build a territory, market, or pipeline where limited existing opportunity existed.
  • Experience developing relationships with executive-level decision-makers and influencing complex buying decisions.
  • Comfort with proactive outbound business development, including cold calling, targeted executive outreach, networking, referrals, and strategic prospecting.
  • The ability to speak specifically about your results — including new logos won, pipeline generated, quota attainment, revenue or gross margin produced, sales cycles, and examples of accounts you personally opened.
  • A competitive, entrepreneurial mindset and the resilience to keep pursuing the right opportunity even when the first answer is “no” or “not now.”
  • Strong closing instincts. You know how to move a conversation forward, challenge assumptions, address objections, create urgency, and ask for the business.
  • A collaborative sales mindset. You recognize that winning the business is only the beginning and actively partner with recruiting and delivery teams to ensure exceptional execution, gather market intelligence, and uncover additional opportunities.
  • Strong business curiosity. You want to understand what’s happening inside an organization and across the market and can connect those insights to talent, project, and workforce solutions.
  • The autonomy and discipline to build your own strategy, prioritize your market, manage your pipeline, and deliver measurable results.

The Hunter We’re Looking For...

You’re someone who naturally asks:

Who aren’t we doing business with yet?

Who do I need to know inside that organization?

What are our recruiters seeing in the market that gives me a reason to call?

What business problem can I uncover before it becomes a requisition?

How do I get the meeting when everyone else is getting ignored?

And once we’re in — where else can we add value?

You don’t wait for leads to appear. You create them.

You don’t view “no” as the end of the conversation. You determine whether it means no, not now, or not yet.

You stay connected to the delivery team because you understand that the best business developers know what clients are asking for, what talent is doing, what competitors are doing, and where the market is moving.

And you don’t measure success solely by activity. You measure it by doors opened, relationships built, pipeline created, new logos won, clients served, and revenue generated.

Why AccruePartners

An Established Brand + A Market to Build – Leverage 20+ years of credibility, expertise, and proven delivery while taking ownership of expanding our presence in one of North Carolina’s key business markets.

Six Specialized Business Verticals – Bring more than one solution to the table with capabilities spanning Accounting & Finance, HR, Corporate Operations, Financial Services, Marketing/Digital/Creative, and IT.

High-Earning Potential – Competitive base, uncapped commissions, and the ability to directly influence your earning potential through the business you create.

Autonomy with Support – Operate with the ownership of an entrepreneur while having specialized recruiting expertise, leadership access, resources, and the established AccruePartners reputation behind you.

High-Performance Culture – Join a company that values accountability, collaboration, authenticity, and celebrating wins — big and small.

Visible Impact – The relationships you create and clients you win will directly influence AccruePartners’ growth across the Triad and broader Carolinas market.

If This Sounds Like You...

If you look at the Triad and immediately start thinking about who you know, who you don’t know yet, and which companies should be AccruePartners clients, we should talk.

This is an opportunity to take an established brand into a market with room to grow — build the relationships, create the demand, leverage the intelligence of an experienced delivery team, and make that growth your own.

We are in an exciting phase of growth, expanding beyond traditional staffing into a broader portfolio of talent solutions and Project Solutions is where that evolution comes to life. We deliver outcomes, not headcount: scoped bodies of work executed by specialized talent and teams.
  • Something new, backed by 24+ years of proven success. You get the upside of an evolving practice with the stability of an established firm behind you.

We keep a clear scoreboard so a real closer always knows where they stand:
  • Own your market. Build and carry a self-generated pipeline of qualified Project Solutions opportunities across the Greater Charlotte metro. Win net-new logos and expand wallet share inside the accounts you open.

  • Win 2+ new solutions deals monthly. Convert pipeline into signed engagements of new scoped bodies of work sold and launched. This is the outcome all the activity drives toward.

How You Win the Work

The hunt opens the door; consultative discipline closes it. You spend the bulk of your time creating and closing demand, and the rest turning conversations into scoped engagements you can win.
  • Listen for the signals. Stay alert for the inflection points that create engagements such as transformation, system or platform implementation, merger and acquisition activity, restructuring.  Uncover the pain beneath the request.
  • Shape the solution. Drive every qualified conversation toward a defined scope, size, timeline, and outcome. Translate a business problem into a scoped body of work.
  • Quarterback the right resources. Pull the VP of Project Solutions forward for heavy solutioning and work with the EVP of Talent & Delivery to attach the right talent at the right time.  Draw on Accrue’s candidate community and line-of-business subject matter experts for the depth each initiative demands. You are never in a room without the firepower to close.
  • Own the throughline. Stay engaged from kickoff through completion so what you sold is what gets delivered keeping scope, quality, and outcome aligned to what the client was promised.

The Team Behind You

You hunt alone, but you never sell shorthanded. Behind every conversation you open sits a bench built to help you win:
  • Six specialized disciplines, each led by a subject-matter expert with deep domain knowledge. You are not expected to be a mile deep in every practice.  You are expected to recognize the signal, ask the right questions, and pull the right expert forward at the right time.
  • Heavy solutioning on demand. A VP of Project Solutions and an EVP of Talent & Delivery ready to scope, size, and staff the engagements you source, so a technical question never costs you a deal.
  • 24 years of market credibility and a tech-enabled recruiting and delivery platform that provides the proof points, references, and speed you need to compete and win up market.
  • Regional roots, national reach. A focus on mid-market and enterprise clients in the Carolinas and Southeast, with a footprint that has organically grown to 42 states and counting.

 

 

The Practice’s Four Pillars

Every opportunity you uncover maps back to one of four solution areas. These pillars are how you qualify a conversation, frame the scope, and know which experts to pull forward. You don’t need to be the deepest voice in any single one; you just need to recognize which pillar a client’s problem lives in and drive the conversation from there.
 
  • Enterprise Program & PMO Leadership. The large, cross-functional programs that reshape how a business runs: ERP implementations and upgrades, post-merger integration, divestiture and separation management, finance transformation roadmaps, enterprise system consolidations, IT governance buildouts, and TSA exit management. Increasingly, this includes standing up AI governance and operating models, leading enterprise AI readiness programs, and providing program oversight for AI and data platform initiatives that cut across the business.
  • Business & Technology Enablement. The systems and data initiatives that modernize the operating core: ERP and CRM selection and rollout, data warehouse and BI builds, data remediation, financial systems modernization, FP&A and EPM tooling, HRIS upgrades, and system integrations across acquisitions. This is also where AI gets built into the operating core: AI and machine learning platform selection and rollout, data readiness and pipeline work that makes AI viable, Copilot and agentic tooling deployment, intelligent document processing, and embedding AI capabilities into ERP, CRM, and BI environments.
  • Operational Readiness & Change Adoption. The people side of change that determines whether an initiative sticks: change management for ERP go-live, communication strategy, organizational redesign, SOP rollout across locations, leadership alignment, training and L&D program design, cultural integration post-acquisition, and first-100-days operating model resets. This is the pillar where most AI initiatives succeed or fail, and it covers workforce enablement and AI literacy, change management for AI-driven process shifts, responsible-use policy rollout, and redesigning roles and workflows around new AI capabilities.
  • Process Optimization & Functional Transformation. The efficiency and controls work that drives measurable financial outcomes: finance close acceleration, order-to-cash and procure-to-pay redesign, shared services buildout, working capital improvement, supply chain redesign, cost takeout, and internal controls redesign. AI is a growing lever here for measurable results: intelligent automation across close, order-to-cash, and procure-to-pay, AI-assisted forecasting and scenario modeling in FP&A, and applied AI that drives cost takeout while strengthening rather than weakening internal controls.

Who Thrives in This Role

First and foremost, you are a hunter. The consulting credibility is what makes you dangerous, but the sales DNA is the price of entry.
  • You are a closer who builds from scratch. You have a proven track record of self-sourced, net-new logos and quota carried and hit. You are comfortable with cold outreach and create opportunities where no RFP, no inbound, and no active buying process exists.
  • You carry a bag and you can hold a scoping conversation, and you see no conflict between the two. You have sold, scoped, or delivered project-based work and sat credibly across from CFOs, COOs, CHROs, and CIOs.
  • You come from mid-market consulting or from industry, where your job was solving complex problems across a diverse set of stakeholders (IT, Finance, HR, Operations, and beyond), giving you the business acumen to diagnose a problem across functions without needing to be the deepest expert in any single one.
  • You are self-directed and market-facing by nature, comfortable owning the full cycle with limited hand-holding. You want the territory, not the safety net.
  • Knowledge of the Greater Charlotte business community is a strong advantage.
Prove the hunt: be ready to walk us through a deal you created where no buying process existed, and a pipeline you built entirely from your own outreach.

job.title: Revenue Partner

Revenue Partner
AccruePartners · Charlotte, NC · Direct Hire · Entry level to 3 years

AccruePartners is expanding and we’re looking for a Revenue Partner to join our internal team and help accelerate firm growth. You’ll join an award-winning firm with 20+ years of market presence, a Carolinas focus with national reach, and a reputation for placing top talent with some of the most recognized companies in the region.

If This Sounds Like You… If you’re ready to build a career somewhere that rewards the effort you put in — you’ll feel right at home at AccruePartners.
